blockingFindings: scripts/lib/security-normalization.mjs uses a private-path regex that requires start-of-string, quote, whitespace, or colon immediately before a filesystem root. Direct local probes returned false for '(/Users/jamie/private.txt)' and 'path=/Users/jamie/private.txt'. Because scripts/check-public-safety.mjs, scripts/lib/projection-consistency.mjs, and scripts/lib/citation-validation.mjs rely on this helper for production-facing content, a private filesystem path in ordinary MDX punctuation can bypass the declared public-safety gate.
